[*] Changed: Reduced texture resolutions.
[*] Changed: Unified Render Pipeline profile usage.
[*] Changed: Capped framerate at 60 FPS.

[*] Changed: Halved reflection resolution.

notes.title: Major Rebuild Update - 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787754/57c44ab0140ec1efa555bc96fee2cd1588c17c9e.png[/img]

Major Rebuild Update - 1.0.3

- Re-Structured/Designed on new URP3D Project in Unity6.
- Added newer player input control.
- Created AES256 encryption with the JSON save logic.
- Changed to IL2CPP scripting backend for game building.
- A preload scene has been added for rendering shaders at start.
- Added a coin void to each side (since they exist on all 'real life' pushers).
- A restyled player queue visual has been added.
- Custom rendering settings on all video quality options.
- Setup 4 video qualities, "good" and "wow" will significantly increase performance. 
- YouTube platform support has been added!
- Completely automated Twitch OAuth token generation and refreshing.
- Automation is Local and tokens are automatically stored.
- OAuth token manager for custom user tokens.
- A visual now shows if OAuth token is valid or expired.
- Better error handling and display.
- New settings manager.
- New ToolTips for all settings.
- Custom commands.
- Color changing logic, real-time reflection and lighting should support changes.
- Gave global Leaderboard its own tab.
- Decreased size in game by 300MB+.
- Coin objects re-made in URP shaders.
- New shaders fixes Emote coin distortions.
- Added Seasons! We begin Season 1 with this milestone update.
- Coin Series 4 added, "The Zodiac".
- New machine cover template added for custom designs.
- Custom Twitch API rebuilt, no longer using WebSocket for connections.
- Restyled Pusher Machine model.
- Shortened the distance the coins are pushed.
- Slowed the pusher speed down.
- Added custom backend logger for more specific error output.
- Added AES256 also to the WeRequests to avoid bad or unwanted requests.
and MUCH more...

Things still not added to the rebuild:
- Streamer Points (this idea is being re-done)
- Coin sounds
- Peg Wall
- Steam Achievements
- Rest of the YouTube integration
- VFX Visuals during gameplay

Things to know:
We wanted to get the rebuild out at least. The rest will be finished up in the next week or two. All settings and saved data will be wiped. The game will install in a new location and you will have to setup all your options again. This is unavoidable since this rebuild is completely different than the original.

Scores are wiped, Season 1 has started.

100% of this game has been rebuilt and re-coded. Please report all bugs as we finely tune it.

notes.title: Sunday Push Report #4 – A Fresh Name and Exciting Updates!
notes.notes:
Hey there, coin pushers!

We’ve got some exciting changes rolling in! Real Coin Pusher is now officially Coin Pusher Live! This new name makes it easier for players to find and better reflects the interactive experience we're building. Same great game, just with a name that fits even better.

But that’s just the beginning. Let’s talk about some big changes coming your way:

[u][b]Level Up with the New Ranking System[/b][/u]
We’re introducing a brand-new ranking system that tracks your progress permanently. No resets, just pure dedication! The more coins you drop, the higher you’ll climb, unlocking new milestones and bragging rights along the way. Whether you're a casual player or a die-hard pusher, your efforts will always count.

[u][b]Seasonal Leaderboards for Competitive Thrills[/b][/u]
To keep things exciting, the viewer leaderboards are getting a complete makeover. We’re moving to a seasonal format, meaning scores will reset periodically, giving everyone a fresh shot at the top. Each season, the most dedicated pushers will walk away with exclusive in-game prizes and ultimate bragging rights.

Streamers, you're in the game too! A separate leaderboard just for you will track your performance on Steam, ranking based on the number of coin drops received from viewers in your channel. Rack up those drops and earn awesome in-game rewards at the end of each season! Streamers can still be on the viewer leaderboards as well by visiting other Coin Pusher Live streams and dropping some coins!

[u][b]More Goodies in the Store[/b][/u]
We’re expanding the in-game store to offer more than just coins. While we're keeping things under wraps for now, expect some exciting new items to personalize your experience and stand out from the crowd. Stay tuned for details soon!

Thanks for being part of the CPL journey. We’re committed to making Coin Pusher Live the best experience possible, and we can't wait to share even more in the coming weeks.

Until next time, happy coin pushing!

notes.title: Sunday Push Report #2 - Expanding to YouTube Chat Streams!
notes.notes:
Hello, RCP community!

It’s time for another Sunday Push Report, and we have some big news! This week, we reached an exciting milestone in our development journey, RCP is now compatible with YouTube chat streams! Expanding beyond Twitch to YouTube opens up the experience to a whole new set of streamers and communities, making RCP accessible to more players and stream interactions than ever before.

Our team worked hard to ensure that this integration offers the same seamless experience, with smooth connections and user friendly setup. Here’s a quick look at what this means:
[list]

[*] [b]Broader Reach[/b]: YouTube integration allows even more streamers and viewers to enjoy the interactive coin pushing experience.
[*] [b]Compatibility[/b]: Streamers now have the ability to connect both their Twitch and YouTube chats, allowing them to play RCP with audiences on both platforms at the same time!
[*] [b]Functionality[/b]: As with Twitch, YouTube users will benefit from the same robust features, with live updates and easy, automated connections to keep games going smoothly.
[/list]
As we continue to build RCP, we’re committed to expanding access and functionality across popular platforms to make it easy for all communities to join in. This week marks an important step toward that goal.

We are excited to keep pushing the boundaries and will have more updates for you next week!

Until next Sunday, happy pushing!

notes.title: Sunday Push Report #1 - Major Rebuild in Progress!
notes.notes:
Sunday Push Report #1 - Major Rebuild in Progress!

Hello, RCP community!

Welcome to the first Sunday Push Report! I’m kicking off this weekly series to keep you all updated on the progress of our exciting rebuild of the game. That’s right, we’re not just updating the current version but completely re-imagining it with a fresh project in Unity 6. This new build will bring enhanced visuals, improved performance, and a smoother experience overall.

We’re also excited to share that the creative direction and community engagement will now be led by our publishing partner. While we’re holding off on revealing their name, rest assured they’re working closely with us to ensure this new version of RCP reflects the vision we all want to see. Their expertise will help shape how RCP looks, feels, and connects with the community.

Here’s a preview of what we’ve been working on:

Game Enhancements

[list]
[*] The game is being fully restructured with the new Universal Render Pipeline (URP), adding richer visuals and effects.
[*] Improved player input controls are in place to make gameplay feel smoother and more responsive.
[*] For added security, we’ve implemented AES256 encryption on save data to keep your progress safe.
[*] Real-life details and push mechanics are making their way into the game, such as a new “coin void” on each side of the pusher, refined push distances, and adjustments to how coins fall and hit the table, all adding to the authentic experience.
[/list]

Twitch Integration

[list]
[*]  Twitch integration has been rebuilt for seamless use, with automated OAuth tokens that keep your sessions active without interruption and without the need to copy/paste any keys.
[*] New visual indicators let you know if your Twitch connection is ready to go, and we’ve added better error handling for smoother connectivity.
[/list]

We’re still keeping some details under wraps, but you can count on new updates every Sunday to track our progress. Your new Coin Pusher experience is coming soon, and I’m looking forward to sharing more with you as we get closer to launch!

Until next time, happy coin pushing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787754/562300c8a80bacae4aa64966c91d70f2f208bb24.png[/img]
Happy Halloween! We have a (late) seasonal update.
Added some decoration goodies and a new coin!

Seasonal Update
- Added Halloween decorations
- Gave the option to hide the decor if wanted
- Removed some unwanted objects
- Fixed UI being small on new saves
- Added New Halloween coin!

notes.title: Hotfix-0.7.18
notes.notes:
Small Fix
- Added spawn blockers for coins that were falling out of place.
- Removed non-used objects that were crowding the file size.

notes.title: Patch-0.7.16 | Coin Series 3
notes.notes:
New Coin Series! 'World Coins' - a set of old style coins from around the globe

- 12 New coins added to the web and in-store games
- Coin Series 1 and 2 have been disabled

notes.title: QoL Update 0.7.09 - 0.7.15
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787754/83f6fcea07b90173e8f6aff2565d1111d6c466f9.png[/img]
Patch 0.7.09 - 0.7.15

QoL Update 

- Overhauled all coin materials and added UV Mapping
- Coins are now double sided
- Streamlined coin shaders for wraps
`- Emote shaders still need some work
- Updated coin spawner amount and positions
- Removed old color picker for own made
- New color pickers for most objects and UI 
- Added Wall Pegs on drop
- Added lights, sound and bounce collision to pegs (can mute)
- Streamlined the UI completely, toggle top right or with [Esc]
- UI objects are now custom and scripted prefabs 
- Added option to hide machine walls
- All coins are now available on web and in-game shops for limited time.

notes.title: Patch Release-0.7.08
notes.notes:
- Changed how we process the data with the game client.
Please report any bugs in Discord involving everything with player data and emotes!

notes.title: Patch Release-0.7.07 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Quick Hotfix:
- Updated coin drag on top collision.
- Updated UI anchoring and positions, nothing should move anymore.

notes.title: Patch Release-0.7.05
notes.notes:
Adjustments & Physics

- Fixed the UI objects that weren't anchoring correctly.
- Re-enabled lurker coins.
- Changed more coin physics to help the top sliding.

notes.title: Patch Release-0.7.04 | Fixes, Additions & Achievements!
notes.notes:
- Added ability to add custom images for machine walls, outside walls and floor.
- Tweaked coin collision to the side slopes, for more coin spread.
- Adjusted coin material size.
- Added button to show texture folders.
- Added refresh button to reload added textures on the fly.
- Removed some in-game textures and assets.
- Updated coin shaders.
- Added more coin and machine physics for collision, to better simulate pushed coins.
- Reduced HDR resolution on all surface reflections. (Should increase performance)
- Added MONEY! We've added crumpled up money and a gold bar with increased values.
`-- The money has a drop rate % when coins drop.
- Added a turn progress bar with current player UI, now shows the drop duration.
- Added tooltips to all settings, text will show below menu buttons when hovering.
- Added color picker options for the UI panels and text.
- Increased Streamer Points per drop from 2 to 10.
- Updated how scripts and objects load. (Should increase performance)
- Added 10 Steam Achievements!

notes.title: Small Hotfix-0.7.03
notes.notes:
Small Hotfix-0.7.03
- Fixed new Store Coins not showing up.
- Tweaked coin physics slightly to reduce jitter/bounce.
- Finished up game menu.

notes.title: Patch-0.7 Notes
notes.notes:
[u][b]Release 0.7.01 Patch Notes[/b][/u]:
- Fixed Emotes being added to the list from server side. (still needs adjusting)
- Increased the packet buffer size from 1024 to 4096 to hold more Emote data.
- Added a toggle option in settings to disable Drop and Queue chat responses.
- Added a toggle to remove ALL reflections.
- Adjusted lighting to display a more uniform green screen.
- Removed custom commands for now, we have plans to revamp.
- UI Objects now save their positions.
- Changed up machine parts to fit in frame better.
- Updated second camera position to show slightly behind lip.
- Tweaked Game Settings and UI.
- Added new Coin Series 2 "Precious Metals" to steam and web stores for limited time.
- Removed Coin Series 1.

Thank you Wayfork@Steam for the bug reports and suggestions.

We appreciate all bug reports and suggestions, no matter how small or crazy. Just remember we can't add every wild suggestion! Be sure to join the discord if you have any questions.

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon(tm)!

notes.title: Hotfixes-0.6.01-0.6.03
notes.notes:
Small Hotfixes for Release-0.6

[b]Game[/b]
- Fixed some settings loading and saving incorrect data.
- Added some setting variables with default values.
- Fixed an issue with twitch instance being inactive while in settings.

[b]Store[/b]
- Fixed MTX and Shop not updating properly.

notes.title: Patch Release-0.6
notes.notes:
[i]Comes with merged Experimental 0.5x builds.[/i]

[h3][b]Game[/b][/h3]
- Added Emote Triggers.
- Added Leaderboards.
- Added separate Local Leaderboard with ability to reset.
- Added ability to set custom drop command and prefix, default !drop.
- Increased lurker reward value from 3 to 5. (still adjusting)
- Increased streamer point rewards from 1 to 2 per !drop.
- Added new HD Textures.
- Added ability to change outside walls and flooring.
- Added Asynchronous Resource loading with textures to reduce lag.
- Added Chat Response categories. Currently added: Default, Comedy, Drama and SciFi.
`- More categories to come, you can change in 'settings' under the Responses button.
- Added 225 total response strings for new categories.

[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
- Re-styled menu sliders.
- Added Leaderboard slider under shop.
- Updated default message box style.
- Updated all button styles.
- Objects behind the glass can be hidden and now saved.
- Added UI scaler to General Settings.
- Updated Coin Shop item layout.

[h3][b]In-Game Steam Store[/b][/h3]
- Added MTX changes. It now goes off of Steam inventory instead of saving data locally. 
`- This will remove any conflicts if they purchase the skins through the Steam Store.
- Added MTX Confirmation Prompt so streamers know to hide their screen of sensitive information.
- Re-Enabled MTX/Items for purchase.

[h3][b]Game Servers[/b][/h3]
- Game will now connect to the game server at startup. It will check again on Twitch connect.
- Added Channel and Global Leaderboard data packet to send client.
- Added Emote list data packet to send client.
- Clients send a packet on connect for Leaderboard and Emotes.
`- In-Game Leaderboards update every 30min.
- Fixed a bug where the client could receive wrong packet data.

[h3][b]Web[/b][/h3]
- Added Emote Coin section to the Shop Profile page.
- Added ability to add up to 3 (of your own) channel emotes as coin wraps.
`- No image upload needed, just click on your emote and it's added!
- Added Leaderboards to the website.
- Added CSS Leaderboard Overlay links for use in OBS.

[h3][b]Direct Links to Leaderboards[/b][/h3]
[url=https://www.littygames.net/leaderboards]Default Boards[/url]
[url=https://www.littygames.net/leaderboards/index.php?sort=top&count=20]Top 20 Board[/url]
Channel Specific: https://www.littygames.net/leaderboards/index.php?sort=top&count=20&channel=<channel_name>
Replace <channel> with any twitch channel name.

You can also replace the count=20 with your own specific count.
Local you can find in-game. Along with direct Leaderboard links, and CSS overlays.

Please note we are still working on tuning in the exchanging and connection between server and game. If you're having problems connecting to the game server, let us know!

If you have any questions, issues or bugs to report, please visit our [url=https://discord.gg/86D84D8Wma]Discord[/url]
